newsitem.title: UK: BA weak as Kleinwort cuts to "reduce".
newsitem.headline: BA weak as Kleinwort cuts to "reduce".

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc eased on Wednesday, against the rising trend in much of the market, as Dresdner Kleinwort Benson cut the stock to "reduce" from "hold," dealers said.
The stock was down 1p at 654 by 0918 GMT in volume of 1.2 million shares, even as the FTSE 100 index gained 27.1 points to 4,903.7.

Dealers said the downgrade largely reflected concerns over the impact of sterling strength and recent strike action by some BA staff. Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
BA shares hit a five-month low of 607-3/8 earlier this month but have rebounded in recent sessions.
The stock gained strength earlier this week after strong demand for the initial offering of Galileo International, the airline reservation system where BA is one 11 airlines holding a stake.
